reviews.x: The reason I wanted to try this eyeliner is because I am getting married soon, and I have not found an eyeliner that will actually stay put on my face. (Why I care so littler during my normal life, I don't know!) My normal go-to is a waterproof self-sharpening pencil from the drug store, but by the end of the day, it always ends up under my eyes, so I resort to wiping my fingers under my eyes every couple hours to maintain.  I read about this eyeliner from some blog about wedding makeup, and, al

Why did it take 49 years to find the perfect eyeliner!! For starters I suck at putting eyeliner on so I normally would only use it when I went out socially. I’d have to bring Qtips with me to constantly clean under my eyes and wipe away at the smudges at the corners. This eyeliner is amazing! I’m still not the greatest at applying it but this goes on so smooth and precise that it’s almost perfect. It doesn’t smudge or melt like any other eyeliner I have used. I keep waiting to pull the Qtip out

reviews.t: Cry all you want and look amazing
reviews.x: I found my cat had passed away in my hallway last night. I put on makeup today and this photo is after ~6 hours of crying on and off. I am wearing Sephora brand eyelashes as well. Highly recommend 10/10

reviews.t: Product in general is Garbage!!  WASTE OF MONEY!
reviews.x: Not the sellers fault this is the actual product failure buyer beware do not buy this liner!!  I keep very very good care of my make up and this eyeliner dried out within a month and I only used it twice in 1 month and the cap was on the whole time and it was in my bathroom drawer.  I did a lot of research on this product and it said it would not come off with watery eyes or crying well it did and it dried out not worth my money!

This eyeliner is wild. I kept buying random big name brands of eyeliner thinking one of them had to be good and not smear and smudge after 1-2 hours. A friend recommended this line to me and I am never going back. I wore this for a full work day and it didnt budge. On top of that, I went on an almost THREE MILE RUN, too lazy to take it off before, and it was still perfect afterwards! If you're looking for a lasting liner, look no further.

This product seems too dry coming out of the bottle. It did not leave a clean smooth line when applying. Did I receive a bad line or an old one? I’m really mad at the cost of this because it’s supposed to be Bad A—- where liners are concerned.  I really wanted this to work.

This eyeliner is my favorite kind. Recently, they changed the tip from a brush like tip to a felt marker kind of tip. Personally, preferred the old tip, but this is still the only eyeliner I use. It lasts all day and is excellent

I am not really satisfied with this eyeliner, despite the hype. The ink seems not distribute evenly so it looks somewhat splotchy and not like what I see in pictures. I may have gotten a dud. It also smudges easily, and the brush tip requires a fair amount of maintenance even though I do not wear eyeshadow or other substances that would clog it.

reviews.t: Good Eyeliner, but it fades with moisture
reviews.x: I like this eyeliner a lot. I just wish that it stayed super pigmented. Unfortunately, it dries a little slowly and if your eyes are in anyway moist, the pigmentation fades. It is, however, better than most liquid eyeliners I have used and it doesn't require rubbing with eye makeup remover to clean it off.

Love love love this brand!! I am a fan!! I little pricey but nothing is as easy to apply and lasts overnight. I use it as my daily go to for eye "touch up" at the outer corners and gorgeous lasting glam look.

Best eyeliner ever. Stays on all day (although I will admit that when I do a cat eye it comes off but I think that's because I absentmindedly rub that part off...). I used to end up with a black line in the middle of my eyelid with other eyeliners as my eyes kind of open real wide but this eyeliner doesn't do that. I've had it for a few months too and it hasn't dried out or faded.  *Edit!! I thought it had dried out today and I was very disappointed. Turns out I just needed to get the tip with s

I purchased the black version of the Ink Liner after one of my best friends recommended it to me. I'm always willing to try a new eyeliner in hopes I'll fall in deep love. I have a love/hate relationship with liquid liner. It's easy to apply, cutting the time it takes to get ready in the morning, however it never seems to be as vibrant as other types of liner (ie: gel).  I used this liner for the first time last night and it went on like a dream. It was dark, created seamless lines, and affordab

Love the fine tip felt point!!  It doesn't interfere with getting ink on my eyelashes like liquids with brush tips do.  I draw big wings that I fill in.  This pin can create very a very sharp point, but has sufficient ink to fill in the wing.  It dries immediately and stays on all day.  I'm so happy I found this product!!!  Please do not every stop making it and do not change anything!!!

reviews.t: throw out all your liquid liners and buy this
reviews.x: This is the only liquid eyeliner anybody should ever buy. The line is very smooth and crisp. The point is fine to make a very light lines or if you pushed down a little harder  you can get a very dramatic line without any run off, smudge or build up.  I've even fall asleep with it on woke up the next day and my liner is still on perfectly. I will never buy another liquid liner.

I was a bit disappointed. it kinda wears off along the lash line during the day. that's weird for me, because I NEVER have to reapply my eyeliner. Never have - even in middle school. If I didn't feel weird about returning something I used on my eyes (and I don't have the box anymore), I'd return it. :( I had heard great things about this brand, but now I'm kinda meh about it.

Don’t get me wrong I love this eyeliner. It goes on smoothly and easily. However, I deducted one star because it will not last on your eyes all day UNLESS you wear eye shadow primer. I use Two Faced and my eyeliner and eye shadow stay on all day.

I love this Eyeliner!!! First one I have ever used -color was great.easy to apply,no smearing or running and looks fabulous !!! Well worth the price which is not bad for a GREAT Eyeliner!!!  Highly recommend!!!!
Buy it! :) Worth it! I love this liner.  It was my first liquid liner and I am so glad I went with this one first.  Love this product! :)

[[VIDEOID:1c1f8216ac9777fd07edb956c52152cb]] Makes a huge mess runs like crazy its' not at all water proof the tips so hard it feels like a blade going across the lid i wear mine on top the lid it lasted a good 4 hrs b4 i needed to apply (NOT WORTH THE MONEY WALMART BRANDS OUT DO THIS BRAND!) by far i think ( superhero IT ) is best I've used! I thought bc its kat that maybe it would wow me but nahhh 😂

reviews.t: At first I Really liked it, now I just sorta like it
reviews.x: At first I Really liked it, now I just sorta like it.  It does last all day but is now starting to leave a line on my eyelid crease. I probably need to start using a primer to prevent this.  It also goes on thick if you're not careful. So far I'm preferring Urban Decay 24/7 waterproof liquid liner.

reviews.t: not as great as they say :(
reviews.x: i was told by many that this was the best stay on liner. after purchasing for myself it does, only if you NEVER touch your eyes. with even the gentlest rub or fingernail itch of your eye it begins to flake :( it has a very fine brush and seems several layers are needed for total coverage.

reviews.t: Amazing product, my favorite eyeliner i've used to date
reviews.x: This goes on so easily and barely needs a touch up. I love this product, it doesn't wipe off. It comes off maybe after sleeping in it or after hours in the pool, but even then, a really impressive amount is left on. But if you take a make-up remover wipe to it, it's not hard to get off.

reviews.t: which at the time I thought it was great. However
reviews.x: I bought this and used it once 2 weeks ago, which at the time I thought it was great. However, I tried to use it this afternoon and it was bone dry. The lid was snapped shut, but it still dried out. It definitely wasn’t worth the money.

It's extremely wet- I use a lot of ink liners and have found that the Kat von D liner is extremely wet for ink liners. It's the expected color which is great! A nice dark, black color. I just wish it wasn't such a damp tip!

I ordered this liner because of all the great reviews but don't waste your money.  I used it once.  Then the tip started to fray and it has completely dried out at the tip.  So, I'm back using my Maybelline eye gel.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the eyeliner for lasting all day and staying put without smudging or budging.
Several reviewers love the fine felt tip for creating sharp, precise lines and easy application.
Some reviewers report the product dries out, applies dry or splotchy, or fades/wears off during the day.
A few reviewers mention smudging or fading with moisture, despite otherwise liking the product.
Some reviewers find it pricey but still consider it worth it or their go-to.
